summary: Compares an input name against the stored name at this+0x1F9C. On match, builds a season-directory + name path string, performs an object-ID lookup, loads and decodes the audio file for the name, then runs settings-file init, a string-buffer copy, and the 5-step session init. Returns 1 on success, 0 on any guard or format/load failure.

operations.description: Load the stored-name pointer at this+0x1F9C; if null, substitute the default directory string byte_5EA438.
Compare input name a2 against the stored name via sub_588410; if it returns 0 (name mismatch), return 0.
Initialize path buffer v9: copy byte_5EA438[0], zero-fill the remainder (0xFC bytes), clear the trailing v10/v11 terminator fields.
Pick the format components: v5 = stored name at this+0x1F9C (or byte_5EA438 default); v6 = dword_5EC3D8 season directory (or byte_5EA438 default).
StringFormatProcessingWithNullTerm(v9, 255, "%s%s", seasonDir, name) builds the season path + name, using path-format-string global aSS; if the result is < 0, return 0.
ObjectIDLookupAcross9Arrays(v9): perform the object-ID lookup on the formatted name/path.
Re-format with the input name: StringFormatProcessingWithNullTerm(v9, 255, "%s%s", seasonDir, a2); if the result is < 0, return 0.
AudioFileLoadDecode(v9, 0): load/decode the audio file for the name; if the unsigned result != 1, return 0.
StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(a2): copy the input name into a managed buffer.
F_5StepInit(this): run the 5-step session initialization sequence.
